description: Use this when you need a metadata catalog for NASA GIBS VIIRS/HLS and NOAA nowCOAST GOES/global IR browser tile layers: layer id, tile URL templates, latest available date, licence and credit. No proxied imagery. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS). GOES/global infrared: NOAA nowCOAST (NESDIS GOES and global satellite partners). CEV-OS serves catalog metadata only; clients fetch tiles directly from NASA/NOAA.
